# AniOracle

> AniOracle is a fan-made anime discovery and entertainment site covering characters, power levels, versus battles, manga, seasonal anime, and AI-assisted exploration.

## Primary sections

- [Home](https://anioracle.online/) — featured anime, trending characters, and discovery tools.
- [Anime Wiki](https://anioracle.online/wiki.html) — anime and character reference content.

## Editorial and rights note

AniOracle is non-commercial and fan-made. Anime titles, character names, images, and related content belong to their respective creators and rights holders.
